"""FFmpeg helpers — all output 1080x1920 (9:16), H.264 + AAC."""

import json
import subprocess

W, H, FPS = 1080, 1920, 30

# scene-grad palette (hex pairs) for gradient backgrounds.
GRADIENTS = [
    ("0x3b2d7a", "0x12102a"), ("0x7a2d55", "0x1c0f22"), ("0x2d5f7a", "0x0f1622"),
    ("0x7a5a2d", "0x221a0f"), ("0x2d7a52", "0x0f2218"), ("0x5a2d7a", "0x180f22"),
]


class MediaError(Exception):
    pass


def run(args: list[str]) -> None:
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise MediaError(f"{args[0]} failed: {p.stderr[-800:]}")


def duration(path: str) -> float:
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "quiet", "-print_format", "json", "-show_format", path],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise MediaError(f"ffprobe failed: {path}")
    return float(json.loads(p.stdout)["format"]["duration"])


def gradient_segment(idx: int, mp3: str, seconds: float, out: str) -> None:
    c0, c1 = GRADIENTS[idx % len(GRADIENTS)]
    src = (
        f"gradients=size={W}x{H}:c0={c0}:c1={c1}:x0=120:y0=0:x1=960:y1={H}"
        f":speed=0.03:rate={FPS}:duration={seconds + 0.5:.3f}"
    )
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", src, "-i", mp3,
        "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0", "-vf", "setsar=1", "-af", "apad",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-r", str(FPS), "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100",
        "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
    ])


def clip_segment(clip: str, mp3: str, seconds: float, out: str) -> None:
    """A downloaded/stock clip cropped to 9:16 with narration audio over it."""
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", clip, "-i", mp3,
        "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0",
        "-vf", f"scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},setsar=1,fps={FPS}",
        "-af", "apad",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
    ])


def trim(clip: str, start: float, end: float | None, out: str) -> None:
    args = ["ffmpeg", "-y"]
    if start and start > 0:
        args += ["-ss", f"{start:.3f}"]
    args += ["-i", clip]
    if end and end > (start or 0):
        args += ["-t", f"{end - (start or 0):.3f}"]
    args += ["-c", "copy", out]
    run(args)


def clip_window(clip: str, start: float, seconds: float, out: str) -> None:
    """Seek to `start`, crop to 9:16, keep original audio, cap to `seconds`."""
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-ss", f"{start:.3f}", "-i", clip,
        "-vf", f"scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},setsar=1,fps={FPS}",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
    ])


def crop_vertical(clip: str, out: str, max_seconds: float | None = None) -> None:
    """Crop a clip to full-frame 9:16 keeping its OWN audio and full length
    (optionally capped). Used by Commentary subtitle mode."""
    args = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", clip,
            "-vf", f"scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},setsar=1,fps={FPS}",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100"]
    if max_seconds:
        args += ["-t", f"{max_seconds:.3f}"]
    args += [out]
    run(args)


def clip_native_segment(clip: str, seconds: float, out: str) -> None:
    """A clip cropped to 9:16 keeping its OWN audio, capped to `seconds`."""
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", clip,
        "-vf", f"scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},setsar=1,fps={FPS}",
        "-af", "apad",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
    ])


def card_segment(png: str, mp3: str, seconds: float, out: str,
                 clip: str | None = None, grad_idx: int = 0) -> None:
    """A full-frame PNG card (with alpha) over a clip or gradient bg + audio."""
    if clip:
        run([
            "ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", clip, "-i", mp3, "-i", png,
            "-filter_complex",
            f"[0:v]scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},"
            f"setsar=1,fps={FPS}[bg];[bg][2:v]overlay=0:0[v]",
            "-map", "[v]", "-map", "1:a", "-af", "apad",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
        ])
    else:
        c0, c1 = GRADIENTS[grad_idx % len(GRADIENTS)]
        src = (f"gradients=size={W}x{H}:c0={c0}:c1={c1}:x0=120:y0=0:x1=960:y1={H}"
               f":speed=0.02:rate={FPS}:duration={seconds + 0.5:.3f}")
        run([
            "ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", src, "-i", mp3, "-i", png,
            "-filter_complex", f"[0:v]setsar=1[bg];[bg][2:v]overlay=0:0[v]",
            "-map", "[v]", "-map", "1:a", "-af", "apad",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
        ])


def vstack_segment(top: str, bottom: str, seconds: float, out: str,
                   keep_top_audio: bool = True) -> None:
    """Two clips stacked into 1080x1920 (each 1080x960), top's audio kept."""
    half = H // 2
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", top, "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", bottom,
        "-filter_complex",
        f"[0:v]scale={W}:{half}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{half},setsar=1,fps={FPS}[t];"
        f"[1:v]scale={W}:{half}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{half},setsar=1,fps={FPS}[b];"
        f"[t][b]vstack=inputs=2[v]",
        "-map", "[v]", "-map", f"{0 if keep_top_audio else 1}:a?", "-af", "apad",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-t", f"{seconds:.3f}", out,
    ])


def replace_audio(video: str, mp3: str, out: str) -> None:
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", video, "-i", mp3, "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0",
        "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-shortest", out,
    ])


def concat(segments: list[str], out: str, workdir: str) -> None:
    import os

    lst = os.path.join(workdir, "concat.txt")
    with open(lst, "w") as fh:
        for s in segments:
            fh.write(f"file '{s}'\n")
    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", lst, "-c", "copy", out])


def burn_subs(video: str, ass: str, out: str, fonts_dir: str) -> None:
    run([
        "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", video, "-vf", f"ass={ass}:fontsdir={fonts_dir}",
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "20", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "copy", out,
    ])

"""Text Story renderer: a fake chat conversation revealed message-by-message
over a gameplay background, each message voiced.

config shape:
{
  "contact": "Grace",
  "dark": false,
  "voiceThem": "ash", "voiceMe": "nova",
  "background": {"type":"clip","url":"..."} | {"type":"upload","path":"..."} | {"type":"gradient"},
  "messages": [{"from":"them"|"me","text":"..."}]
}
"""

import os
import shutil
import tempfile

from PIL import Image

from engine import media
from engine.chat_card import render_state
from engine.downloader import fetch
from engine.tts import synth
from renderers.scenes import Output, RenderContext

DATA_DIR = os.environ.get("RENDER_DATA_DIR", "/data")
GAP = 0.35
MIN_MSG = 1.1


def _bg_clip(bg: dict) -> str | None:
    if bg.get("type") == "clip" and bg.get("url"):
        try:
            return fetch(bg["url"])
        except Exception:
            return None
    if bg.get("type") == "upload" and bg.get("path"):
        p = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, bg["path"])
        return p if os.path.exists(p) else None
    return None


def render_text_story(config: dict, ctx: RenderContext) -> Output:
    messages = [m for m in config.get("messages", []) if (m.get("text") or "").strip()]
    if not messages:
        raise ValueError("text story has no messages")
    contact = config.get("contact", "Contact")
    dark = bool(config.get("dark"))
    style = config.get("style", "imessage")
    v_them = config.get("voiceThem", "ash")
    v_me = config.get("voiceMe", "nova")
    clip = _bg_clip(config.get("background") or {})

    workdir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"text-{ctx.export_id}-", dir=ctx.data_dir)
    try:
        segments = []
        for i in range(len(messages)):
            ctx.progress(10 + int(78 * i / len(messages)), f"Message {i + 1} of {len(messages)}")
            msg = messages[i]
            # voice the current message
            mp3 = os.path.join(workdir, f"m{i}.mp3")
            voice = v_me if msg["from"] == "me" else v_them
            synth(msg["text"].strip(), voice, mp3)
            dur = max(MIN_MSG, media.duration(mp3) + GAP)
            # render the conversation revealed up to message i
            png = os.path.join(workdir, f"card{i}.png")
            render_state(messages[: i + 1], contact, style=style, dark=dark).save(png)
            seg = os.path.join(workdir, f"seg{i}.mp4")
            media.card_segment(png, mp3, dur, seg, clip=clip, grad_idx=i)
            segments.append(seg)

        ctx.progress(90, "Assembling")
        joined = os.path.join(workdir, "joined.mp4")
        media.concat(segments, joined, workdir)

        ctx.progress(96, "Publishing")
        out_dir = os.path.join(ctx.data_dir, "exports", ctx.export_id)
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
        video_abs = os.path.join(out_dir, "final.mp4")
        os.replace(joined, video_abs)
        # transcript as the "srt" companion (plain text conversation)
        srt_abs = os.path.join(out_dir, "captions.srt")
        with open(srt_abs, "w") as fh:
            fh.write("\n".join(f"{m['from']}: {m['text']}" for m in messages))
        return Output(
            video_path=os.path.relpath(video_abs, ctx.data_dir),
            srt_path=os.path.relpath(srt_abs, ctx.data_dir),
        )
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)

"""Scenes renderer: narration scenes -> TTS -> per-scene background (gradient
or stock/downloaded clip) -> concat -> karaoke caption burn-in -> 9:16 MP4.

config shape:
{
  "voice": "ash",
  "caption": "pop",
  "scenes": [{"narration": "...", "background": {"type":"gradient"} | {"type":"clip","url":"..."}}]
}
"""

import os
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass

from engine import media
from engine.captions import Word as CapWord, build_ass, build_srt
from engine.downloader import fetch
from engine.tts import synth

MIN_SCENE = 2.0
TAIL = 0.35
FONTS_DIR = os.environ.get("FONTS_DIR", "/app/fonts")


@dataclass
class RenderContext:
    export_id: str
    data_dir: str
    progress: callable  # (pct:int, step:str) -> None


@dataclass
class Output:
    video_path: str | None = None  # relative to data_dir
    srt_path: str | None = None
    extra: list | None = None  # [(kind, path)] for non-video assets


def render_scenes(config: dict, ctx: RenderContext) -> Output:
    scenes = [s for s in config.get("scenes", []) if (s.get("narration") or "").strip()]
    if not scenes:
        raise ValueError("no narration scenes to render")
    voice = config.get("voice", "ash")
    caption = config.get("caption", "pop")

    workdir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"render-{ctx.export_id}-", dir=ctx.data_dir)
    try:
        timeline: list[CapWord] = []
        segments: list[str] = []
        t0 = 0.0
        for i, scene in enumerate(scenes):
            ctx.progress(10 + int(70 * i / len(scenes)), f"Scene {i + 1} of {len(scenes)}")
            mp3 = os.path.join(workdir, f"s{i}.mp3")
            words = synth(scene["narration"].strip(), voice, mp3)
            dur = max(MIN_SCENE, media.duration(mp3) + TAIL)
            for w in words:
                timeline.append(CapWord(w.text, t0 + w.start, t0 + min(w.end, dur)))
            t0 += dur

            seg = os.path.join(workdir, f"seg{i}.mp4")
            bg = scene.get("background") or {"type": "gradient"}
            if bg.get("type") == "clip" and bg.get("url"):
                try:
                    clip = fetch(bg["url"])
                    media.clip_segment(clip, mp3, dur, seg)
                except Exception:
                    media.gradient_segment(i, mp3, dur, seg)  # fallback
            else:
                media.gradient_segment(i, mp3, dur, seg)
            segments.append(seg)

        ctx.progress(82, "Assembling the cut")
        joined = os.path.join(workdir, "joined.mp4")
        media.concat(segments, joined, workdir)

        ctx.progress(88, "Timing karaoke captions")
        ass = os.path.join(workdir, "subs.ass")
        with open(ass, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(build_ass(timeline, caption))
        final = os.path.join(workdir, "final.mp4")
        media.burn_subs(joined, ass, final, FONTS_DIR)

        ctx.progress(96, "Publishing")
        out_dir = os.path.join(ctx.data_dir, "exports", ctx.export_id)
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
        video_abs = os.path.join(out_dir, "final.mp4")
        srt_abs = os.path.join(out_dir, "captions.srt")
        os.replace(final, video_abs)
        with open(srt_abs, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(build_srt(timeline))
        return Output(
            video_path=os.path.relpath(video_abs, ctx.data_dir),
            srt_path=os.path.relpath(srt_abs, ctx.data_dir),
        )
    finally:
        import shutil

        shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)

"""Video Ranking renderer: a Top-N countdown built from social-video URLs.

config shape:
{
  "title": "Top 5 Snake Attacks",
  "voice": "atlas",
  "caption": "pop",
  "clipSeconds": 6,          # per-rank duration when there's no narration
  "ranks": [                 # given in display order (usually #N down to #1)
    {"rank": 5, "url": "https://...", "narration": "Number five..."},
    ...
  ]
}

Each rank: download the clip → crop to 9:16 → (narration ? TTS voiceover +
karaoke captions : native clip audio). One ASS burn adds the persistent
title + big rank number plus the karaoke captions.
"""

import os
import shutil
import tempfile

from engine import media
from engine.captions import Word as CapWord, _cues, _esc, _ts, _STYLES, _FX, TAIL
from engine.downloader import fetch
from engine.tts import synth
from renderers.scenes import Output, RenderContext

FONTS_DIR = os.environ.get("FONTS_DIR", "/app/fonts")
MIN_SEG = 2.0
NARR_TAIL = 0.35


def _ranking_ass(title: str, windows: list[dict], caption_style: str) -> str:
    """windows: [{start, end, rank, words:[CapWord]}] on the global timeline."""
    cap = _STYLES.get(caption_style, _STYLES["pop"])
    fx = _FX.get(caption_style, "")
    header = f"""[Script Info]
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: 1080
PlayResY: 1920
WrapStyle: 0
ScaledBorderAndShadow: yes

[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding
Style: Title,Anton,74,&H00FFFFFF,&H00FFFFFF,&H00000000,&H00000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,1,0,1,5,3,8,60,60,120,1
Style: Rank,Anton,150,&H0033D6FF,&H0033D6FF,&H00000000,&H00000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,6,4,8,60,60,300,1
{cap}

[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text
"""
    lines = []
    for w in windows:
        s, e = _ts(w["start"]), _ts(w["end"])
        if title:
            lines.append(f"Dialogue: 0,{s},{e},Title,,0,0,0,,{_esc(title)}")
        lines.append(f"Dialogue: 0,{s},{e},Rank,,0,0,0,,#{w['rank']}")
        for cue in _cues(w["words"]):
            parts = []
            for i, cw in enumerate(cue):
                until = cue[i + 1].start if i + 1 < len(cue) else cw.end
                k = max(1, int(round((until - cw.start) * 100)))
                parts.append(f"{{\\k{k}}}{_esc(cw.text)}")
            lines.append(
                f"Dialogue: 0,{_ts(cue[0].start)},{_ts(cue[-1].end + TAIL)},C,,0,0,0,,{fx}"
                + " ".join(parts)
            )
    return header + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def render_ranking(config: dict, ctx: RenderContext) -> Output:
    ranks = [r for r in config.get("ranks", []) if r.get("url")]
    if not ranks:
        raise ValueError("ranking has no ranked clips with URLs")
    title = config.get("title", "").strip()
    voice = config.get("voice", "atlas")
    caption = config.get("caption", "pop")
    clip_seconds = float(config.get("clipSeconds", 6))

    workdir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"rank-{ctx.export_id}-", dir=ctx.data_dir)
    try:
        segments: list[str] = []
        windows: list[dict] = []
        t0 = 0.0
        for i, r in enumerate(ranks):
            ctx.progress(10 + int(70 * i / len(ranks)), f"Rank {i + 1} of {len(ranks)}")
            clip = fetch(r["url"])  # download via the scraper service
            seg = os.path.join(workdir, f"seg{i}.mp4")
            narration = (r.get("narration") or "").strip()
            words: list[CapWord] = []
            if narration:
                mp3 = os.path.join(workdir, f"n{i}.mp3")
                tts_words = synth(narration, voice, mp3)
                dur = max(MIN_SEG, media.duration(mp3) + NARR_TAIL)
                for w in tts_words:
                    words.append(CapWord(w.text, t0 + w.start, t0 + min(w.end, dur)))
                media.clip_segment(clip, mp3, dur, seg)
            else:
                dur = clip_seconds
                media.clip_native_segment(clip, dur, seg)
            segments.append(seg)
            windows.append({"start": t0, "end": t0 + dur, "rank": r.get("rank", len(ranks) - i), "words": words})
            t0 += dur

        ctx.progress(84, "Assembling the countdown")
        joined = os.path.join(workdir, "joined.mp4")
        media.concat(segments, joined, workdir)

        ctx.progress(90, "Adding titles & captions")
        ass = os.path.join(workdir, "overlay.ass")
        with open(ass, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(_ranking_ass(title, windows, caption))
        final = os.path.join(workdir, "final.mp4")
        media.burn_subs(joined, ass, final, FONTS_DIR)

        ctx.progress(96, "Publishing")
        out_dir = os.path.join(ctx.data_dir, "exports", ctx.export_id)
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
        video_abs = os.path.join(out_dir, "final.mp4")
        os.replace(final, video_abs)
        # SRT from all narration words
        from engine.captions import build_srt

        all_words = [w for win in windows for w in win["words"]]
        srt_abs = os.path.join(out_dir, "captions.srt")
        with open(srt_abs, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(build_srt(all_words))
        return Output(
            video_path=os.path.relpath(video_abs, ctx.data_dir),
            srt_path=os.path.relpath(srt_abs, ctx.data_dir),
        )
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)

"""Social video downloader microservice.

Wraps yt-dlp with the pieces that make scraping actually work from a
datacenter IP (empirically validated 2026-07):

  - TikTok  : works with no auth.
  - YouTube : needs a POT (proof-of-origin) token from the bgutil provider
              AND authenticated cookies. POT alone is NOT enough from a
              flagged datacenter IP.
  - Instagram: needs authenticated cookies.

Cookies are mounted per-platform at /cookies/<platform>.txt (Netscape
format). A residential proxy (PROXY_URL) removes the IP flag and makes
YouTube work without cookies; it is the more robust long-term option.
"""

import os
import shutil
import tempfile
from typing import Optional
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
import yt_dlp

app = FastAPI(title="VidForge Downloader")

POT_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("POT_BASE_URL", "http://pot-provider:4416")
COOKIES_DIR = os.environ.get("COOKIES_DIR", "/cookies")
DOWNLOAD_DIR = os.environ.get("DOWNLOAD_DIR", "/data/downloads")
PROXY_URL = os.environ.get("PROXY_URL", "").strip()

os.makedirs(DOWNLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def platform_of(url: str) -> str:
    host = (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower()
    if "tiktok" in host:
        return "tiktok"
    if "instagram" in host:
        return "instagram"
    if "youtube" in host or "youtu.be" in host:
        return "youtube"
    return "other"


def cookie_file(platform: str) -> Optional[str]:
    path = os.path.join(COOKIES_DIR, f"{platform}.txt")
    return path if os.path.exists(path) and os.path.getsize(path) > 0 else None


def build_opts(url: str, outtmpl: str) -> dict:
    platform = platform_of(url)
    opts: dict = {
        "outtmpl": outtmpl,
        "format": "bv*[height<=1080]+ba/b[height<=1080]/b",
        "merge_output_format": "mp4",
        "noplaylist": True,
        "quiet": True,
        "no_warnings": True,
        "retries": 3,
        "extractor_args": {},
    }
    if PROXY_URL:
        opts["proxy"] = PROXY_URL

    if platform == "youtube":
        # POT provider for the web client; cookies still required on a
        # flagged datacenter IP unless a residential proxy is in play.
        opts["extractor_args"]["youtubepot-bgutilhttp"] = {"base_url": [POT_BASE_URL]}
        opts["extractor_args"]["youtube"] = {"player_client": ["web_safari", "default"]}

    ck = cookie_file(platform)
    if ck:
        opts["cookiefile"] = ck
    return opts


class DownloadRequest(BaseModel):
    url: str


class ProbeRequest(BaseModel):
    url: str


class SearchRequest(BaseModel):
    query: str
    limit: int = 20
    shorts: bool = False


@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "pot_base_url": POT_BASE_URL,
        "proxy": bool(PROXY_URL),
        "cookies": {
            p: cookie_file(p) is not None for p in ("youtube", "instagram", "tiktok")
        },
    }


@app.post("/probe")
def probe(req: ProbeRequest):
    """Fetch metadata only (no download) — used by the UI to preview a URL."""
    opts = build_opts(req.url, os.path.join(DOWNLOAD_DIR, "%(id)s.%(ext)s"))
    opts["skip_download"] = True
    try:
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
            info = ydl.extract_info(req.url, download=False)
    except yt_dlp.utils.DownloadError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=_friendly(str(e), req.url))
    return {
        "platform": platform_of(req.url),
        "id": info.get("id"),
        "title": info.get("title"),
        "duration": info.get("duration"),
        "thumbnail": info.get("thumbnail"),
        "uploader": info.get("uploader"),
        "view_count": info.get("view_count"),
        "width": info.get("width"),
        "height": info.get("height"),
    }


@app.post("/download")
def download(req: DownloadRequest):
    workdir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dl-", dir=DOWNLOAD_DIR)
    outtmpl = os.path.join(workdir, "%(id)s.%(ext)s")
    opts = build_opts(req.url, outtmpl)
    try:
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
            info = ydl.extract_info(req.url, download=True)
            path = ydl.prepare_filename(info)
            if not path.endswith(".mp4"):
                base, _ = os.path.splitext(path)
                if os.path.exists(base + ".mp4"):
                    path = base + ".mp4"
    except yt_dlp.utils.DownloadError as e:
        shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=_friendly(str(e), req.url))

    if not os.path.exists(path):
        shutil.rmtree(workdir, ignore_errors=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="download produced no file")

    rel = os.path.relpath(path, DOWNLOAD_DIR)
    return {
        "platform": platform_of(req.url),
        "id": info.get("id"),
        "title": info.get("title"),
        "duration": info.get("duration"),
        "width": info.get("width"),
        "height": info.get("height"),
        "path": rel,
        "size_bytes": os.path.getsize(path),
    }


@app.post("/search")
def search(req: SearchRequest):
    """YouTube search for content research — returns clips ranked by
    views-per-day so outliers (ideas that overperform) surface first.
    Uses yt-dlp (no API key needed)."""
    import datetime

    q = req.query.strip()
    if req.shorts and "#shorts" not in q.lower():
        q = f"{q} #shorts"
    n = max(1, min(50, req.limit))
    opts = {
        "quiet": True,
        "no_warnings": True,
        "extract_flat": "in_playlist",
        "skip_download": True,
    }
    if PROXY_URL:
        opts["proxy"] = PROXY_URL
    try:
        with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
            info = ydl.extract_info(f"ytsearch{n}:{q}", download=False)
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"search failed: {e}")

    items = []
    for e in info.get("entries", []) or []:
        if not e:
            continue
        views = e.get("view_count") or 0
        dur = e.get("duration") or 0
        # crude recency-normalized score; upload date isn't in flat results,
        # so rank primarily by views, favoring short-form durations.
        score = views * (1.4 if dur and dur <= 75 else 1.0)
        items.append({
            "id": e.get("id"),
            "title": e.get("title"),
            "url": e.get("url") or (f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={e.get('id')}"),
            "channel": e.get("channel") or e.get("uploader"),
            "channel_url": e.get("channel_url") or e.get("uploader_url"),
            "views": views,
            "duration": dur,
            "thumbnail": e.get("thumbnails", [{}])[-1].get("url") if e.get("thumbnails") else None,
            "score": score,
        })
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
    return {"query": q, "count": len(items), "results": items, "at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}


def _friendly(err: str, url: str) -> str:
    platform = platform_of(url)
    if "Sign in to confirm" in err or "empty media response" in err or "login" in err.lower():
        have = cookie_file(platform) is not None
        if not have:
            return (
                f"{platform} requires authenticated cookies from this server's IP. "
                f"Add /cookies/{platform}.txt (Netscape format from a logged-in "
                f"account), or configure a residential PROXY_URL."
            )
        return (
            f"{platform} cookies present but rejected — they may be expired or the "
            f"account flagged. Refresh /cookies/{platform}.txt."
        )
    return err.splitlines()[-1][:300] if err else "download failed"

---
name: videforge-project
description: "VidForge — new viblo.ai-clone video SaaS at /opt/videforge, target videos.revsports.ca. Fresh build, no shared code with reelsmith/clipforge."
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: df07ea6b-b519-4295-86a4-4383e6a6e727
---

VidForge (working name, user can rename) is a from-scratch viblo.ai clone started 2026-07-06. User explicitly said: start fresh, DO NOT reuse code from the Reelsmith/ClipForge tests ("came out terribly"). Repo `/opt/videforge` (git, main). Target deploy: videos.revsports.ca (DNS already → Cloudflare/this host). Source recording: `/viblo.mp4` (15min walkthrough; frames in scratchpad/vframes).

**Viblo feature map** (11 tools, left sidebar): Text Story (fake iMessage/Tinder/WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger chat over gameplay b-roll), Video Story, Video Commentary (URL/upload→trim→script→subtitle→shape→audio), Split Screen, Video Ranking (Top-5 from pasted YT/TikTok/IG URLs), Auto Clipping, Generate AI Voiceover, Video Transcriber, AI Image Generator, AI Video Generator, Video Downloader. Auth = magic-link + OTP. Wizards have live 9:16 phone preview.

**SCRAPING SOLUTION (the user's #1 pain point, empirically solved 2026-07-06 on this datacenter IP):**
- TikTok: works cookieless via yt-dlp.
- YouTube: POT provider (bgutil `brainicism/bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider` on :4416) is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT alone — still hits "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" across web_safari/mweb/tv/web clients. Needs cookies OR residential proxy.
- Instagram: needs cookies OR proxy.
- Durable fix: residential/mobile PROXY_URL (best) or per-platform Netscape cookies at /cookies/<platform>.txt (rot over time). Built into the downloader service both ways.

**Done so far**:
- `services/downloader` FastAPI microservice (yt-dlp+POT+cookies, /health /probe /download) + pot-provider compose service. Proven: TikTok downloads through the API; YouTube returns actionable cookie-required error.
- `web/` Next.js 16 app: passwordless auth (magic link + OTP, `/api/auth/request|verify|logout|me`), JWT session cookie (jose), edge middleware guards `/app`. Prisma 6 (NOT 7). SMTP mailer (nodemailer) with **dev log-fallback**: when SMTP unconfigured, the login code is printed to the web container logs — that's how to log in until SMTP is set. Studio dashboard with 12-tool sidebar. Prod build + lint green.
- **Admin account seeded: haxkodi@gmail.com, role=admin, unlimited (credits bypassed).** To log in now (no SMTP yet): request a code at /login, then `docker compose logs web | grep -A2 'VidForge login'` for the 6-digit code. Override admin email via ADMIN_EMAIL. Re-seed: `cd web && npm run seed`.
- Postgres in compose (dev exposed on 127.0.0.1:5434). Migration `init` applied.

- `services/worker` (Python) — the shared render engine: edge-tts word timings, ASS karaoke captions (pop/clean/neon/mono), ffmpeg 1080x1920 compositor (gradient bg + downloaded-clip bg via the downloader service), DB-backed RenderJob queue (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), progress + Asset rows. `renderers/scenes.py` is the first renderer (video_story/voiceover types). Proven end-to-end: 2-scene job (gradient + TikTok clip through the scraper) → 11s 9:16 H.264 with karaoke captions, frames visually confirmed. Worker in compose.

**LIVE at https://videos.revsports.ca** (deployed 2026-07-07). Cloudflare → nginx `/etc/nginx/conf.d/videos.revsports.ca.conf` (72.62.69.9, shared hstgr cert) → web container 127.0.0.1:3400. **Compose services**: db, pot-provider, downloader, worker, web (+ migrate one-shot, profile tools). Deploy flow: commit → `git -C /opt/videforge pull` (if remote) → `docker compose up -d --build web worker` → `docker compose run --rm migrate`.

**Admin login**: SMTP not configured, so login codes print to `docker compose logs web`. For the user, generate a one-click magic link: insert a LoginCode row for haxkodi@gmail.com with a random token + future expiry, give them `https://videos.revsports.ca/login/verify?token=<token>` (single-use, sets 30-day session). A 7-day bootstrap link was handed over on 2026-07-07. Configure SMTP_* env (root .env) for real email login.

- **Video Ranking tool (#12 done)** — first full tool, end-to-end. Web API layer built: `/api/projects` CRUD, `/api/projects/[id]/render` (credit charge via `lib/credits.ts`, admin-exempt), `/api/jobs/[id]` poll, `/api/assets/[id]` authed download. Worker `renderers/ranking.py`: downloads each clip via scraper → 9:16 crop → per-rank TTS (or native audio) → one ASS burn (persistent title + big rank number + karaoke captions) → concat countdown. UI `/app/ranking`. Proven as admin: 2 TikTok clips → 7s MP4 with title/#rank/captions, frame confirmed. `lib/api.ts` + `lib/presets.ts` are the client helpers for future tools.

**ALL 12 TOOLS BUILT & LIVE (2026-07-07).** Renderers in services/worker/renderers: scenes (video_story/voiceover), ranking, commentary, text_story (PIL iMessage cards, engine/chat_card.py), split_screen, transcriber + auto_clip (faster-whisper base, CPU, model cached at /data/models), plus AI image/video gen. Worker Output generalized: optional video + `extra` [(kind,path)]; RenderResult shows all assets. Tools:
- Self-hosted & working: Text Story, Video Story, Commentary, Ranking, Split Screen, Auto Clipping, AI Voiceover, Transcriber, Downloader, Content Research (yt-dlp ytsearch — works cookieless!).
- Provider-gated (no GPU here): AI Image Gen (Replicate flux-schnell) + AI Video Gen (Replicate, REPLICATE_VIDEO_MODEL) via lib/replicate.ts + /api/generate-media. Activate by adding REPLICATE_API_TOKEN to root .env (like the LLM/Anthropic pattern). Show clean "connect a provider" state until then.

LLM script-writing: lib/llm.ts (Anthropic, mock until ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set) + /api/generate for commentary/ranking/text-story. Uploads: /api/upload → /data/uploads. Web build pattern: `npm run build` only validates locally — MUST `docker compose up -d --build web` to deploy route/page changes into the container (foot-gun hit once).

Pending only: SMTP for email login (still magic-link via logs/generated token), and the optional ANTHROPIC/REPLICATE/PROXY keys.

**2026-07-07 fidelity pass** (user pushed back hard: "voices suck, nothing like viblo" — they were right; I'd built from a partial read of the walkthrough). Re-analyzed the full 15-min video (214 frames, contact sheets in scratchpad). Fixed the two biggest gaps:
- **Voices**: edge-tts now uses natural *Multilingual* voices (Andrew/Ava/Brian/Emma), removed pitch/rate distortion. ElevenLabs auto-upgrade when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set (with-timestamps endpoint for word timing; each preset maps edge+el). `services/worker/engine/tts.py`.
- **Text Story**: `engine/chat_card.py` rewritten — 5 authentic skins (imessage/whatsapp/instagram/tinder/messenger, light+dark, profile pic). Style picker in builder; live preview reflects skin colors. Verified Instagram gradient bubble + WhatsApp green header render end-to-end.

**Fidelity tasks #18-21 all DONE (2026-07-07)**:
- (18) Background LIBRARY: 12 built-in animated gradients (synced media.GRADIENTS ↔ web/lib/backgrounds.ts + CSS vf-grad-0..11), `BackgroundPicker` (Animated/Stock/Upload/URL tabs; stock=Pexels-gated `/api/library/stock` on PEXELS_API_KEY). Wired into Text Story + Video Story; renderers honor gradient idx + upload/clip. Split Screen keeps 2-clip inputs. **Constraint stated to user: can't host copyrighted gameplay; real gameplay loops need PROXY_URL.**
- (19) Commentary subtitle mode = default: full-frame clip + own audio + whisper auto-captions (media.crop_vertical). voiceover mode optional. Verified.

content.text:
You were right, and it was a real bug — not just missing polish. I found it and fixed it.

**What was actually broken:** the downloader saved every clip into folders that only `root` could read (mode `0700`), but the web app runs as an unprivileged user. So the web server got **"Permission denied" on every downloaded file.** That silently broke two things:
1. **Pasted clips never appeared** — my preview only showed a grey placeholder box, never your actual video. So you pasted a TikTok link and nothing loaded, exactly as you said.
2. **The Downloader tool's "Save video" link** was also failing for the same reason.

You were also right that I'd "copied the UX" — the preview was showing a fake placeholder for clips instead of the real thing. That's now genuinely fixed:

- Downloads are readable by the web app (permission fix).
- Assets serve inline with HTTP range support, so `<video>` can actually play them.
- A new resolve endpoint downloads a pasted URL and hands back a playable link.
- **Paste a URL → click "Load" → your actual clip loads and plays in the preview**, across Text Story, Video Story, Commentary, and Ranking (plus uploads preview instantly, and stock plays directly).

**Verified in production, not just claimed:** resolving a TikTok URL returns HTTP 200 with a valid playable MP4 (and range requests work); the Downloader tool's save link now returns the real 1.7 MB file.

Here's a fresh login link to try it yourself — go to Text Story or Ranking, paste a TikTok URL, hit **Load**, and the video should appear in the phone preview:

**→ https://videos.revsports.ca/login/verify?token=d61f72b87c98f4faefbe9811be09184d1a74bcdd641abc14b0a6a3b0b1b872b2**

If a TikTok link still doesn't load after clicking Load, tell me exactly which tool and what you see (an error message, a spinner that never stops, etc.) and I'll trace that specific path — but this specific bug (files unreadable) is fixed and tested. One honest note: YouTube/Instagram URLs will still say they can't load without the proxy/cookies we discussed, because this server's IP is blocked by those two platforms — TikTok works because it isn't.
